name: provenant
description: Turn the AI copyright war into a market. Training-manifest royalties on Portaldot.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @provenant/core && npm run test -w @provenant/contracts && npm run test -w @provenant/native
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w web
scripts.verify: npm run build:core && npm run compile && tsx verify/verify.ts
scripts.verify:offline: npm run build:core && npm run compile && tsx verify/verify.ts --offline
